cards.title: Separate Procedure
cards.summary: CPT 38100 is generally not separately payable in this clinical context. Payable estimate adjusted accordingly.
cards.text: Separate ProcedureCPT 38100 is generally not separately payable in this clinical context. Payable estimate adjusted accordingly.Learn More ▾⚠️ CPT 38100 is a separate-procedure splenectomy code. When splenectomy is performed only to manage an iatrogenic splenic injury during another abdominal operation, it is generally not separately reportable. If the splenectomy was performed for trauma, pre-existing splenic disease, malignancy, abscess, hypersplenism, or a distinct indication, separate reporting may be supportable with documentation.CPT 38100 is integral to CPT 44140 in this separate-procedure relationship. Selected/performed line is visible but excluded from payable estimate.Separate-procedure codes may be separately reportable only when performed at a distinct encounter, distinct anatomic site, or for a clinically independent indication supported by documentation.Modifier use should not bypass a same-incision or same-clinical-context separate-procedure relationship unless payer policy and documentation clearly support distinct work.If documentation shows substantially increased work on CPT 44140, review whether modifier 22 is supportable. Do not use modifier 22 to make the separate-procedure code payable.
